fixed_budget.stopping: unchanged HOLD and linear speed<=0.005 for 40 frames, else watchdog

primary.unit: paired condition within one seed block; not nine independent random seeds
primary.development_continue_gate: candidate nets >=2 additional completions vs both legacy and feedback_fix, loses <=1 prior success vs either; no new execution error or hard recorded safety violation
primary.interpretation: development screening only; neither significance nor proof of safety

candidate.information: own fused local map, received neighbour positions, own displacement/velocity estimate, existing task and common phase signals
candidate.fixed: perception, progress estimator/gain, steering gains, contact engine, safety constraints, phase/stop/success thresholds, initial state, random seed
candidate.normal_allocation: nonnegative least squares with 0.01 identity augmentation, normalized max coefficient=1; pressure role >0.05
candidate.relocation: deficit persists contact_dwell*dt; observed patch within local_radius; normal improvement > push_share_floor; normal dot current >0; no occupied or closer-neighbour target
candidate.relocation_budget: max3 attempts per robot, each <=2*local_radius/max_speed; one contact_dwell cooldown; total task clock unchanged
candidate.clearance: max(hold_offset, robot_radius+voxel_size); tangent only after within 0.01m; unchanged QP always runs
candidate.known_limit: No new lateral stop gate or relaunch after HOLD; estimates may be biased; local map does not establish full wrench feasibility

analysis_rules.denominator: all 27 launched/planned episodes; errors and watchdogs retained
analysis_rules.endpoints: all nine pairs with signed differences, no post-hoc exclusions
analysis_rules.timing: failed-task termination time is not completion time
analysis_rules.safety: report raw minimum clearances, penetration, solver fallbacks/scalings and original G500; no new tolerance
analysis_rules.default_compatibility: all replay arrays and all old per-frame scientific fields must exactly match frozen legacy cases; new diagnostic-only keys excluded explicitly
analysis_rules.stopping: one candidate version only; failure records remain, no tuning/reruns to achieve success
